author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal + Motif Stochastic Depth (p=0.05) — seed=42
abstract: Tiny stochastic depth (p=0.05) on the motif branch during training; regression heads keep RegCal ON; no LogitNorm. Hypothesis: smoother early dynamics improve CRI-On/Off without harming others.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from hdp_regcal_motif_stodepth import create_network, create_optimizer

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        "learning_rate": 0.001,
        "hidden_dim": 256,
        "kernel_size": 7,
        "dropout_rate": 0.10,
        "ds_dilations": [1,2,4,8,16],
        "motif_k": 5,
        "head_dropout": 0.05,
        "weight_decay": 0.01,
        "regcal_on": True,
        "p_stodepth_motif": 0.05,
        "logitnorm_alpha": 0.0,
        "logitnorm_apply_to_multilabel": False,
        "logitnorm_order": "dropout_then_norm",
        "logitnorm_bias_multiclass": False
    }
